mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the permission matrix definition allows the matrix to be populated arbitrarily (e.g., CustomerRole granted PostDecision). The LeastPrivilege assertion checks that only the documented cells are allowed; if the fact is removed, a counterexample with unauthorized role-operation pairs will be found.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_UnauthorizedPermission { CustomerRole -> PostDecision in PermMatrix.allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: This fact ensures every decision has a corresponding audit event. Removing it allows decisions to exist without audit entries, violating the append-only invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingAuditEvent { some dec: Decision | no evt: ApplicationEvent | evt.application = dec.application and ((dec.decisionType = ApprovedDecision and evt.eventType = ApprovedEvent) or (dec.decisionType = RejectedDecision and evt.eventType = RejectedEvent)) }

mutation_targets.rationale: This constraint enforces the business rule that a customer can have at most one pending application at a time. Removing it allows multiple pending applications for the same customer, violating FR-005 and the access-control invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MultiplePendingPerCustomer { some disj app1, app2: LoanApplication, u: User | app1.customer = u and app2.customer = u and app1.status = PendingReview and app2.status = PendingReview }

mutation_targets.rationale: This fact ensures only one decision can exist per application. Removing it allows multiple decisions to be recorded for the same application, violating the concurrency-safety invariant and allowing duplicate decisions despite the spec's requirement that only the first wins.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateDecision { some disj dec1, dec2: Decision | dec1.application = dec2.application }

mutation_targets.rationale: This fact requires every application to have a submitted event. Removing it allows applications to exist without submission audit entries, violating the completeness invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingSubmittedEvent { some app: LoanApplication | no evt: ApplicationEvent | evt.application = app and evt.eventType = Submitted }
